sloka: ते भिन्नगात्राः समरे वानराः शपपीडिताः।पेतुर्मथितसङ्कल्पाः सुरैरिव महासुराः ।। ६.७३.३५ ।।
transliteration: te bhinnagātrāḥ samare vānarāḥ śapapīḍitāḥ।peturmathitasaṅkalpāḥ surairiva mahāsurāḥ ।। 6.73.35 ।।

translations.english: Struck in the battle by Indrajith, the Vanaras rained heavily armed with trees and rocks.
